rationale: Codebase-pin regression check at 293ef0ee (round-2 I had zero asks; duty is regression-only, block only on spec-branch-corrupting defects — none found). Helper-built-map fixtures: genuine and honest. TestFindUnguardedPhaseWrites_CatchesHelperBuiltUpdateMapEvasion pins exactly the dataflow shape I probed empirically in round 2 (map built in a separate helper, passed opaquely to a MergeMetadata-shaped call), asserts exactly one violation AND that attribution lands on the builder function; its companion proves the closure-nested-inside-the-lock case stays unflagged. The doc comment is truthful about mechanism — it is a positive proof of existing per-file walker semantics, not a new dataflow analysis — and the narrowed residual ('a key or map... that never appears as a visible composite literal or index-assignment ANYWHERE in the scanned tree') is precisely accurate, since a cross-file helper's literal is scanned in its own file and flagged there. I re-derived at this commit: the same helper shape planted in a REAL production file (internal/complete) turns TestMindspecPhaseWritesAllLockGuarded red, attributed to the builder (probe_helper.go:4 func probeBuildUpdate). Warning-text assertion updates are honest adaptations, not weakenings: 'could not sync phase metadata' is the real production wording of the new phase.DescribeLockFailure (phaselock.go:141-143), both updated tests (impl i3 done-write, plan p4) inject at the UNCHANGED seams (implPhaseMetadataFn/planMergeMetadataFn) and still require the distinctive substring; the five best-effort sites all supply copy-pastable idrender-wrapped re-run commands, and only a genuine ErrPhaseLockTimeout earns the recovery line — other errors render as-is with no manufactured recovery. Ratchet 8->7 for ApproveImpl Sprintf(...epicID...) matches an actual site removal visible in the diff (the done-marker warning's raw-epicID Sprintf replaced by DescribeLockFailure with idrender.Spec(specID)) — a decrease backed by code, not gate-weakening; internal/lint green enforces the exact count. Suites at 293ef0ee: go build OK; internal/phase + internal/approve + internal/lint + full cmd/mindspec all green with -count=1 (uncached); the 8 walker/lock tests (including the crashed-holder subprocess test) green under -race. Bead worktree left byte-identical, no phase.lock residue.
